comparison.objective: Zero an unpowered robot joint by holding the link at its reference mark and inserting a calibration pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually support and finely align a movable link while inserting a pin through coincident holes.
comparison.success_condition: Joint is on the zero mark, pin is fully seated, assembly is stable, and hands withdraw.
comparison.reason: This is the closest generic alignment/insertion neighbor, but it tests static hole coincidence and pin insertion. The candidate uniquely tests a sliding transfer over a maintained support seam with four rows of freely simulated balls that may escape.
